description: Cross-check cases for app/lib/controller/controller_images.dart: each input was run through the Pi controller's controller/atalaia_controller/images.py check() (Python standard library zlib) by a one-off script; 'status' and 'message' are its ImageError, otherwise the result's type, size and the SHA-256 and length of the stripped file. The inputs are the branding test files (controller/tests/fixtures/branding) and small PNG, JPEG and WebP files made by hand.

cases.name: animated.png
cases.message: animated PNG is not accepted

cases.name: animated.webp
cases.message: animated WebP is not accepted
